title: [Main] Inconsistent Non-Deductible VAT calculations on Purchase & Sales Invoices containing lines with Full VAT calculation type
summary: Fixes inconsistent Non-Deductible VAT calculations on purchase and sales invoices that contain lines with the Full VAT calculation type. Small additions are made to the Purchase Line and VAT Amount Line tables across the W1 and localized base apps, with new tests.
key_points: Fixes inconsistent Non-Deductible VAT results on invoices with Full VAT lines
Small additions to the Purchase Line table in W1 and all localized layers
VAT Amount Line table also adjusted in W1, APAC, BE, ES, GB, IT, NA and RU
New tests added to the Non-Deductible VAT posting test codeunit
